text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond is training hard, but I can't help but feel that she's pushing herself too much to break this jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask Mejiro McQueen to join us for training, and she happily accepts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While out for a jog, Satono Diamond buys herself a drink that will supposedly help break her jinx that prevents her from winning races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Mejiro McQueen points out that the reason she's losing is because she is focusing on the jinx when she ought to be focusing on her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, Satono Diamond decides to dedicate herself to improving her form.
